trips.name: Tiburon Explorer
trips.description: Tiburon Explorer liveaboard caters to 16 divers with 9 air-conditioned staterooms, modern amenities, and social areas. It offers 7-night dive trips to Galapagos Islands' best sites, including pelagics, endemic marine iguanas, and land tours.
